plain: A vassal who holds land from a lord in return for service.

webster.text: A tenant or vassal who holds his lands of a superior, on condition of military service; the tenant of a feud or fief.

example.quote: Had no external dangers enforced internal harmony and subordination, and particularly, had the local sovereigns possessed the affections of the people, the great kingdoms in Europe would at this time consist of as many independent princes as there were formerly feudatory barons.
